# rixl_video_hot_segments (Data Source)

Identifies peak replayed and highest-engagement segments within a video asset.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "rixl_video_hot_segments" "popular_moments" {
  video_id = var.rixl_video_id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `video_id` (String)

### Optional

- `rangeend` (String) The range.end query parameter.
- `rangestart` (String) The range.start query parameter.

### Read-Only

- `segments` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--segments))

<a id="nestedatt--segments"></a>
### Nested Schema for `segments`

Read-Only:

- `end_second` (Number)
- `multiplier` (Number)
